## Summary

Describe the behavioral change and the affected experiment or artifact.

## Validation

- [ ] `make check-repository`
- [ ] `make audit`
- [ ] `make test`
- [ ] `make compile`

## Reproducibility

- [ ] No secrets, virtual environments, downloaded datasets, or raw results are included.
- [ ] Any new external method declares its upstream URL and pinned commit.
- [ ] Any prompt-level adaptation is labeled as such.
- [ ] New tracked artifacts include SHA-256 provenance.
